functionSignature.name: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization
functionSignature.returns: TABLE (authorization_id UUID, command_id UUID, decision_evidence_id UUID, decision_version INT, decision_digest TEXT, reservation_id UUID, cancellation_release_id UUID, paid_bridge_id UUID, payment_attempt_id UUID, provider_origin_kind TEXT, provider_payment_ref TEXT, approved_amount_paise BIGINT, currency TEXT, issuing_role TEXT, issuing_principal TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, replayed BOOLEAN)
functionSignature.security: VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp SET row_security = on
functionSignature.roleGate: Enforces session_user = 'encho_refund_issuer' OR pg_has_role(session_user, 'encho_refund_issuer', 'MEMBER'); raises REFUND_ISSUER_UNAUTHORIZED otherwise
orderingAndGates: 1. Caller validation: verifies session_user has role encho_refund_issuer
2. Input validation: non-null command, reservation, and evidence UUIDs

3. Evidence admission: verifies permitted_issuer_role = 'encho_refund_issuer', permitted_submitting_component = 'REFUND_DECISION_AUTHORITY_PRIMITIVE', classification = 'LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE', matching reservation_id
4. Reservation root lock: SELECT ... FROM canonical_reservations FOR UPDATE
5. Semantic command fingerprinting: SHA-256 over canonical JSONB payload

6. Replay check: returns stored authorization with replayed = true if command matches; raises REFUND_COMMAND_CONFLICT on conflict; raises REFUND_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED if reservation/evidence already bound to different command

7. Canonical subject derivation: latest event CANCELLED by INTERNAL_DECISION for ENCHO_DIRECT, unique V1 cancellation release with effective version 1 and revision NULL, matching night counts, zero sealed V2 revisions, COMMITTED paid bridge, APPROVED payable authority with currency INR

8. Reconciliation gates: payment attempt locked FOR UPDATE; state MATCHED_CAPTURE; matched_at NOT NULL; reconciliation_reason IS NULL; zero unresolved payment reconciliations; authority hash matches expected_authority_hash

9. Capture group verification: coherent PROCESSED capture group, unique payment ref and order ref, ceiling >= approved amount > 0, supporting event verified, zero cross-attempt aliases, capture uniqueness check
10. Atomic insertion: inserts into canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations; catches unique_violation for race recovery; returns complete table projection with replayed = false

rolePrivileges.provisioningSemantics: The role encho_refund_issuer is an unprivileged login role pre-provisioned in the database environment (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION). Migration 061 validates these least-privilege properties via DO $grant_refund_issuer$ block before granting USAGE on schema public and EXECUTE on function issue_cancellation_refund_authorization.
grants: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO encho_refund_issuer
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION issue_cancellation_refund_authorization(UUID, UUID, UUID) TO encho_refund_issuer

absenceOfExtraPrivileges.tableDml: ZERO direct INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or SELECT on canonical_cancellation_refund_decision_evidence, canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations, canonical_reservations, canonical_reservation_nights, canonical_payment_attempts, canonical_payment_reservations, canonical_provider_events, booking_holds, inventory_days, or stays_quotes
absenceOfExtraPrivileges.schemaCreate: ZERO CREATE on schema public or current_database()
absenceOfExtraPrivileges.superuser: NOT rolsuper, NOT rolbypassrls, NOT rolcreatedb, NOT rolcreaterole, NOT rolreplication

T01.title: Valid paid V1 cancellation plus admitted synthetic decision returns complete authorization
T01.evidence: Successfully issued refund authorization with replayed = false; all derived bindings match canonical records; verified row persisted in canonical_cancellation_refund_authorizations

T02.title: Payable differs from room subtotal: follows payable/capture authority
T02.evidence: 2-night reservation with 1,100,000 paise room subtotal and 1,300,000 paise payable authority; approved amount 1,200,000 paise exceeds room subtotal but remains within captured ceiling; successfully authorized

T03.title: Missing/forged approval, permission denials, inner role guard, and decision_ref check constraint
T03.evidence: Non-existent evidence rejected; unauthenticated caller rejected with 42501; role without issuer permission rejected with REFUND_ISSUER_UNAUTHORIZED; issuer direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/SELECT on evidence and authorization tables denied with 42501; empty string and whitespace-only decision_ref rejected with SQLSTATE 23514

T04.title: Cross-resource evidence/authorization insert rejection
T04.evidence: Independent database triggers reject mismatched reservation, mismatched cancellation release, mismatched paid bridge, mismatched payment attempt, and mismatched capture ref on both tables

T05.title: Natural scope exclusions: ACTIVE/request-only, external, direct-only, and V2 exclusions without disabling triggers
T05.evidence: ACTIVE uncancelled reservation rejected at trigger with CANCELLATION_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND; REQUEST-ONLY reservation rejected with CANCELLATION_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND; direct-finalizer-only rejected with PAID_BRIDGE_NOT_FOUND; external channel reservation rejected with LIFECYCLE_ORIGIN_NOT_SUPPORTED; naturally assembled and sealed V2 reservation cancellation rejected at issuance with V2_CANCELLATION_RELEASE_EXCLUDED; zero triggers or foreign keys disabled

T06.title: Invalid amount/currency, conflicting capture, unresolved reconciliation
T06.evidence: Approved amount > capture ceiling rejected with REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE; natural conflicting capture transitions attempt to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and is rejected with PAYMENT_STATE_NOT_MATCHED_CAPTURE; unresolved reconciliation in table rejected with PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_UNRESOLVED; visible cross-attempt alias rejected with CAPTURE_CROSS_ATTEMPT_ALIAS_AMBIGUOUS without trigger tampering

T07.title: Equivalent duplicate captures yield one ceiling (no summing)
T07.evidence: Two duplicate capture events for same attempt verified in DB; attempting to authorize 2x captured amount rejected with REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE; authorizing single captured ceiling succeeds

T08.title: Exact authorized replay after later financial observations on the same payment attempt
T08.evidence: Later conflicting capture ingested on the exact same payment attempt transitions it to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; replaying the original command succeeds with replayed = true returning identical authorization; verified count(*) remains exactly 1 with 0 new rows added; replay with changed semantics rejected with REFUND_COMMAND_CONFLICT; unauthorized caller replay attempt rejected with 42501

T09.title: Two real connections: identical converge under active lock contention, competing blocked
T09.evidence: Connection A holds open transaction with row lock; Connection B attempts identical command concurrently; Connection B's lock wait is actively observed in pg_locks and pg_stat_activity (granted = false); Connection A commits, Connection B converges cleanly (one insertion, one recovery replay, 1 row total); distinct competing command on same reservation rejected with REFUND_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED

T10.title: Immutability, structured injected rollbacks, and zero domain row mutation across 16 tables
T10.evidence: UPDATE and DELETE rejected on evidence and authorizations by immutability triggers; T10A outer transaction abort rolls back with SQLSTATE 22P02 leaving 0 authorizations and 16 domain tables unchanged; T10B injected fixture trigger rolls back with SQLSTATE P7777 / REVIEW_REFUND_AUTHORIZATION_INSERT_FAILURE leaving 0 authorizations and 16 domain tables unchanged; T10C clean issuance leaves 0 mutations across all 16 scoped domain tables

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Cross-resource consistency between authorization and decision evidence is enforced by database trigger

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Only completed V1 ENCHO_DIRECT cancellations are eligible for cancellation refund authorization

invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization checks payment_state, reconciliation_reason, and canonical_payment_reconciliations table; verified in focused test T06b

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Duplicate captures on the same attempt do not sum to create inflated refund ceiling
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization takes the maximum individual captured amount; verified in focused test T07

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Ambiguous cross-attempt alias of capture reference is detected and rejected
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization verifies distinct payment_attempt_id count is exactly 1; verified in focused test T06c

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Exact command replay returns existing committed authorization without re-issuing or mutating state
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: issue_cancellation_refund_authorization returns stored row with replayed = true; verified in focused test T08a with exactly 1 row persisted

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Later conflicting financial observations on the same attempt do not invalidate existing committed replay
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Conflicting capture event ingested on payment attempt; replay still succeeds with replayed = true and count remains 1; verified in focused test T08a

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Conflicting command replay with changed semantics is rejected
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Replaying same command_id with different reservation or evidence raises REFUND_COMMAND_CONFLICT; verified in focused test T08b

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Concurrent identical issuance requests serialize via reservation root lock and converge safely
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Two real connections execute identical command concurrently; Connection B observed actively waiting on lock in pg_locks/pg_stat_activity; both converge with one inserted, one replayed, 1 row total; verified in focused test T09a

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Competing distinct issuance requests for the same reservation are rejected
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Second distinct command for same reservation raises REFUND_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED; verified in focused test T09b

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Transaction rollback on outer failure leaves zero persisted authorizations and leaves 16 domain tables unchanged
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Outer transaction abort raises SQLSTATE 22P02, rolls back; verified 0 authorizations and exact 16-table snapshot equality in focused test T10A

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Transaction rollback on injected trigger failure leaves zero persisted authorizations and leaves 16 domain tables unchanged
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Injected trigger on authorizations raises SQLSTATE P7777, rolls back; verified 0 authorizations and exact 16-table snapshot equality in focused test T10B

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Successful refund authorization issuance causes zero mutation across all 16 canonical domain tables
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: 16 scoped domain tables snapshotted before and after successful issuance; deep equality verified in focused test T10C

invariantsAndAttributions.invariant: Restricted issuer role encho_refund_issuer has least privilege and zero raw DML permissions
invariantsAndAttributions.evidence: Migration 061 DO block validates encho_refund_issuer is non-superuser, non-bypassrls, has no CREATE on public or database, and zero table DML; verified in SQL review and focused test T03c-e

trustBoundariesAndLimitations.syntheticEvidenceBoundary: Decision evidence admitted in local testing is explicitly classified LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE with verifying component DISPOSABLE_TEST_FIXTURE_RUNNER. It does NOT represent a real founder or human approval.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.missingApprovalRegistrar: Production approval registrar is NOT implemented in this slice. A future dedicated registrar service must verify real human financial approval and write ACCOMMODATION_FINANCE_APPROVAL_RECORD evidence.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.zeroMoneyMovement: This slice authorizes refund intent within the canonical database only. Zero money movement, zero Razorpay/Stripe API dispatch, zero payout execution, zero wallet crediting, and zero ledger settlement occur.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.noRemainingRefundableBalanceAccounting: This slice does not maintain a cumulative refund ledger or remaining refundable balance. Future slices must enforce partial-refund accounting before settlement.
trustBoundariesAndLimitations.publicSurface: Zero public HTTP/REST/GraphQL routes or UI elements are exposed. All functionality is internal database routines under role encho_refund_issuer.
